ctx.x: Did you have the San Jacinto then?

The San Jacinto. We worked from Rhapsody to San Jacinto. And we had nice engagements from jobs to jobs, you know. And there for a while. Beansie still would take out the money for his violin until it was paid for. Well, after it was paid for, they had another fella by the name of Jerry Green. And Jerry Green, he joined the band, which was a bass player, and he'd taken the violin over. And he worked with them for years and years and years. After then, the band broke up for some cause. And then the violin come back…
You heard it back? No, you can hear it. I don't know. I've heard of it. You heard of it.
